reviews.text: Handled my sassy older Aussie beautifully and she looks incredible after her grooming. I used to drive almost an hour to a groomer I trusted but thankfully I found The Hairy Dog. Pricing was transparent and communication was stellar.

My shih tzu loves going to see Kara at The Hairy Dog every 8 weeks for her grooming appointment! She gets so excited when I tell her where we are going. Kara does a great job and loves Hazel as much as Hazel loves her!
The best doodle groomer I’ve ever been to. My Luna baby’s been going here for 3+ years
I have been using Hairy dog every 6 weeks for over 5 years. My dogs goes happily and always looks great

I have been taking my pup to Hairy Dog since she was 6 months old. They take amazing care of her and I would not trust anyone else with her. Jenn and the whole team treat her like family. Highly recommend the amazing people at Hairy Dog!!!

We’ve always had a great experience with The Hairy Dog on Duncan! They do an excellent job and he always comes back looking great, happy, and well cared for. The staff is friendly, professional, and clearly treats the dogs with care. Highly recommend The Hairy Dog for grooming!

We have been going to The Hairy Dog for years now and they have been so great to our dogs. Our little white mix senior, Harris is well-cared for and always feels fresh and happy after. Our lab, Nattina is a nervous lady, but she doesn't ever seem stressed to go, and she looks so fluffy and clean every time. We've recommended them to all our friends and family.
I’ve been getting my dogs haircut here for over 2 years and they do an amazing job. My poodle always comes out looking well groomed with every groomer!

We only have good things to say about The Hairy Dog! Lazlo is our first pup and our friends recommended we bring him here for grooming and he has been going every 4-6 weeks since then. They do a great job with a very energetic pup and he always seems excited to go there which I’ve heard is not always the case for dogs and grooming! Requesting appointments or modifying appointments online has been really easy and I appreciate they have weekend hours since I don’t work from home and weekday grooming would be tough to coordinate.
We asked for a profile trim of our golden retriever. He came back looking beautiful. They have always done a great job and my dog loves going there.
Great service, makes dogs feel comfortable, great grooming
Super awesome! Our dog always come back groomed so well!
We use THD for each of our doodles and they do a great job. Staff is always friendly and accommodating. Highly recommend!
My pup Annie and her brother are Kaleena and she’s the best. The staff knows them, takes care of them, and gets as much of a kick of out their shenanigans as we do at home.

We absolutely love The Hairy Dog and Kara Richards! We’ve been bringing our doodles here for about five years, and Kara does an amazing job every single time. They always come home looking like the cutest little teddy bears! 🐻🐾
One of our doodles is pretty skittish, so it means so much to us knowing that they take the time to make her feel safe and comfortable. I also LOVE that they don’t crate the dogs, which was really important to us when choosing a groomer.
After five years, we completely trust Kara and The Hairy Dog with our babies. It’s such a great feeling knowing they are not only going to look adorable, but that they are being well cared for while they’re there. We wouldn’t take them anywhere else! ❤️
The Hairy Dog does a wonderful job of grooming even the most skittish of dogs. They always do a great job and listen to notes and things you want addressed. Very communicative.

We have been using The Hairy Dog for years.  The last two visits, however, there have been issues and we weren't notified.  One time a toenail was cut too short and since we didn't know, we let him walk around when he got home and it started bleeding again leaving marks across the floor.  The last time, a mole on his leg was cut.  It has now been a month, and we still need to use the cone alternating with a wrap to keep him from licking the spot.
I left a message online after the toenail incident, but never heard back.  The last incident I am guessing it was because we forgot to request our usual trimmer, and the new person didn't review any notes about moles to watch out for.
Words cannot express the satisfaction I have with this groomer shop. My cats turn out so lovely, and come back relaxed and untraumatized.

Everyone that works here is super nice and friendly. My dog always comes back smelling amazing, super fluffy and clean. They kept a good amount of fur on him while still getting him clean and handsome. Love this place!
We have been going to hairy dog for years! I drive 150 miles each way to groom my dogs because they do an exceptional service
We have been going for years and the team has always been awesome to work with, Nena always comes out perfect🐾

My dogs always come out looking like what I asked for. They are patient with my 14 year 11 month old cavalier who is pretty unsteady on her feet. Plus my 7 year old and her barking. I really really appreciate the woman at the front desk who sees when I’m there and comes and carries Motzie in and back out when I pick them up. I drive all the way from Anthem as I wouldn’t take then anywhere else.

They have a wonderful team of groomers! I have two dogs and don’t use one dedicated groomer, so I schedule with whoever is available at a time that works for me. No matter which groomer we see, my dogs always look great. They offer plenty of appointment options, and the entire staff is consistently friendly and welcoming.

We were recommended by several friends and have not been disappointed. Our Labradoodle and Golden always come back looking fantastic—soft, beautifully groomed, and noticeably less shedding. We really appreciate the attention to detail, friendly service, and how our groomer takes time at drop-off to discuss what we want and offer great suggestions. Excellent experience from drop-off through pickup, and our dogs always look their best.

Ophelia does a great grooming job on Josie and we’ve been going to The Hairy Dog for years. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer as they truly care for your pup and make safety/cleanliness a priority! Even though we recently moved further away to the East Valley area, we will still make the drive because it’s worth it!

We've been bringing our golden retriever here for over a year, and we couldn't be happier. Our dog absolutely loves the staff and gets excited every time we pull up. He also loves playing with the other dogs while he's there. He always comes home clean, fluffy, great-smelling, and happy. Highly recommend!
Kaleena always does such a nice job on our doodle. We’ve been coming for years and will continue to go there for all future grooming appointments

We love the Hairy Dog Groomers!  They take such good care of Daisy.  No matter how scruffy she gets, they always make her beautiful!  She loves her spa day!  If you are looking for a quality place to get your fur baby groomed, consider the Hairy Dog.  They're the BEST!  <3

We have been bringing our dog JJ here for years and they have always done such a great job! She always leaves happy. We love that they know who JJ is when we bring her in and they love her like their own dogs. Her haircut is always perfect. She has had issues with dry skin in the past after grooming but they listened to the concern and we haven’t had an issue since grooming with them. They are amazing! (Here’s a little before and after!)
My dog, Max has been getting groomed here for over 3 years. He was timid at first. He has come around n loves his trips there. Super friendly, helpful staff who love what they do🐶 …
We always love the cut, and our doodle runs in the door when we get there! They are very kind and patient.

can’t say enough great things about The Hairy Dog! They are always kind, professional, and do an amazing job. The location is fantastic—right here in Arcadia, super easy to get to, with plenty of parking. There are also great restaurants across the street and even a Ross, so it’s a perfect place to wait and do some shopping while Jacoby gets groomed. Jacoby is my 9-pound Shih Tzu, and every time he gets a haircut, he looks absolutely adorable. The grooming is typically $70 to $80, which is a bit on the pricey side, but it’s totally worth it—he always comes out happy, well-cared for, and ready for nap. I also love that they take dogs who are spayed or neutered. I highly recommend The Hairy Dog for your pup’s grooming!

My pups love the Hairy Dog. They come home spiffy and clean! Shh... don't tell the fed's Kirby voted, I don't want her to get deported.

And although Omar Little (lil O')  has passed, she enjoyed getting a full makeover at HD after being found on the streets in horrible condition.

We have been taking our Golden Retrievers to be groomed monthly since The Hairy Dog opened at the original location and through their expansion. Each puppy has always been treated as special and the dogs love being there. I trust the owner and staff and have never been disappointed or dissatisfied.
Best groomer ever!!  Our pup gets the best service consistently and loves going yo visit.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We’re so grateful for your support and appreciate you taking the time to leave us a little love! 🤍 …

I’ve been taking my dog to The Hairy Dog every two months for over a year now and have had a great experience every time! The staff are friendly and helpful, the grooming is always great, and the prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend :)
Friendly place, and a great grooming job done on my 2 poodles.
I brought my older Shih Tzu to this location for the first time and was very pleased with my overall experience! All of the staff was very friendly and the process of booking online was seamless.
They always take great care of my cava poo. Baxter always comes home looking fresh and snappy. I am able to get an appointment as needed, and the staff is very friendly.
I’ve used the Hairy Dog for the past 5 years for my pup and have been pleased with the grooming. They are efficient and easy to work with.
Great experience -- our dog comes back fresh and neat! Pleasant staff, and online booking is super convenient.

The staff is always friendly, helpful and delivers a consistent cut. My dog always looks great and comes home happy from being around the other dogs. I recommend going here for any of your dog hair cut needs!

The best of the best, very professional, very sweet with Toby, he’s always happy after his bath, never a bad experience.
Very recommended!!!
Ophelia always does a great job on my dog!
Best groomer we’ve ever had. I travel 45 miles to go to Hairy Dog.  I highly recommend them!!

This is the only groomer that I trust with my buddy Gus, a 12 year old Havanese! Gus always looks fantastic and you can tell he knows it too by the added pep in his step! They are so gentle and patient with Gus whose downy undercoat is easily matted.
They do a consistently good job and listen to my preferences.
For my three girls, they look forward to coming back here. I appreciate how they take their time with each one. Collette "Coco", Penelope Wonderful "Penny", and Daisy Mae.
Always get awesome services from the Hairy Dog!
We have been going to Hairy Dog for years now, to get our Bernedoodle groomed. We always schedule with Kaleena, and he comes out looking so handsome every time. Cannot recommend this place enough

Oliver loves The Hairy Dog! This is the only groomer that I can drop off my dog and feel great knowing he will look gorgeous every single time I pick him up.  Everyone is warm and welcoming and makes the dogs and parents feel comfortable. So happy we found you!! 🐶

I’ve been taking Bijou to the Hairy Doog for several years and she is always ready to go inside, which she has never done for any groomer before. Kara does such a fantastic job every single time - I know she will be in great and caring hands when I leave her.

We have had our dogs groomed here for about 6 years. Overall, we have been satisfied with their services. Their staff is friendly and they have a nice facility (with multiple safeguards to make sure pets can't escape). We recommend them!

We love The Hairy Dog! We’ve been bringing our dog Reggie here for grooming and haircuts and always have such a great experience. Everyone is so friendly and takes great care of him, and he always comes home looking amazing. They do such a great job with his cut every time, and I always feel comfortable knowing he’s in good hands while he’s there. Definitely recommend The Hairy Dog to anyone looking for a great groomer in the area!
Everyone at The Hairy Dog is friendly and kind. Shara does a fantastic job grooming my Luca and we're always excited to visit🩵
The best cuts for our Pomsky, she always looks amazing!

I love this place!! The receptionist is always so cheerful and welcoming. My dog, a poodle mix, was rescued from the streets and has some issues but they are very understanding and take great care of him. He always comes out looking great! I recommend this place to my friends.
My standard poodle has been coming here for a number of years. We have a few groomers who we prefer and they always do a great job.

We absolutely love bringing Gracie here! ❤️ From the moment we walk in, she is treated with so much kindness, care and patience. They do such a beautiful job with her grooming, and she always comes home looking absolutely adorable and feeling happy.

It’s such a relief knowing your fur baby is in good hands, and we couldn’t be happier with the care Gracie receives. You can truly tell they love what they do. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

We have been taking my two golden doodles to The Hairy Dog for several months now and they do an amazing job! The staff is always kind, the facility is clean and efficient and our girls always look wonderful!
The best groomers in town. Always so sweet and leave my dog looking the best!.
Bring both of my dogs here. They are always professional and give the spaniels great haircuts!
They treat your pup as their own.
Rocky loves every visit to The Hairy Dog! Kalina and the staff are so great to work with. They really care about your dog I mean family member.

Hairy Dog is the absolute best!  We were referred by a friend and it was the best referral.  Wadsworth knows when we are a block away and sits up in the car and can't wait to get out.  It is free range and he has made so many friends!.  The even told us when he had a skin allergy and sure enough we went to the vet and he had an allergy and we went home with cream.  They treat your dog like it is their own!   I would NEVER go to any one BUT Hairy Dog!!!
Love the way they love my dog!
I send my Cavalier King Charles to Hairy Dog. She is well taken care of and always looks her best post appointment!
Ophelia does a fantastic job on our Saint Bernard’s, couldn’t recommend her enough for big dogs
The staff at the hairy dog are exceptional and our pups come out looking amazing. Highly recommend their services.
Kara always does a fantastic job grooming my Westie, Annie.  Plus Annie loves hanging with all the groomers and other dogs.  The care and detail shown is exceptional.
The Hairy Dog does such a great job with my Goldendoodle. The haircut is very consistent and my pup comes home smelling so good. We love this place!  Highly recommend!!!!
Kara is the best always makes my girl look beautiful
Excellent service, they genuinely care about your dog. I’ve been to several groomers in the area, by far the best around town!

I called The Hairy Dog with a few questions, and they were more than helpful. They went above and beyond to answer everything thoroughly and make sure I had all the information I needed. Their customer service is a solid 10/10. Everyone I spoke with was incredibly polite, friendly, and genuinely kind. It’s so refreshing to interact with a business that takes the time to make you feel heard instead of rushing you off the phone. I highly recommend them based on the outstanding customer service alone!

This is the only place I don’t have anxiety taking my pup to get groomed. Staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable. My girl Luna loves the attention she gets!

Plus side it’s easy to make an appointment online and upload all documents needed. I’ve been coming here for 6 years and I will never not bring my dog. You guys are the best!!
Great place to get your pooch well groomed! Friendly staff and people that care.

Don't waste your time with this business. Called them 12 times with no answer to get an appointment. Booked 6 weeks ahead,  came in and they asked that I present my dogs rabies vaccine. I had to dig through my email and call the vet, took me 15 minutes to have it sent. They then turned me away because i was late, even though I arrived early and they did not let me know I would need this prior to my appointment. I wasted over an hour of travel time to be treated this way. I wasted my time, don't waste yours...they don't care about their customers
I've taken my did here for years now, they do a great job and are very friendly 😊
They always do a great job on our dog. He’s so excited to go that he starts shaking with excitement when we pull up :)
We've been taking our canine companion here for almost five years. She gets well cared for and enters through their gates on her own with tail wagging. Worth every penny.
The only place I could find that had the coyote vest sold locally and not only online. My yorkie needed to try it on before buying and thank God we got one in his size.

I’ve taken my dog here twice, and both times he came back with cuts and razor burn. The last visit was especially bad—he had severe cuts and razor burn on his private area, so painful that he couldn’t walk. He eventually developed an infection that required a vet visit, antibiotics, and other medication, costing me over $300.

While the staff refunded half of the grooming fee, they ignored my follow-ups afterward. When I finally spoke with the manager, I was told it was my fault because my dog was “too matted.” For the record, my dog was not matted. That kind of response and lack of accountability is unacceptable.

I would never recommend this place to anyone who cares about their pet’s safety and well-being

The hairy dog is amazing! I do make a 30 minute drive to Phoenix. But it’s honestly so worth it. Both my fur babies have been going to the hairy dog over the past few years now. The staff is amazing with my boys, and so very nice. My little guy does get spooked going to groomers and vet. But they’re great on making him feel at home and relaxed durning his appointment.

My dog Teddy is the first dog I ever parented that would not let me trim nails. Not only did the staff handle Teddy with care, they did an excellent job including a nail trim. We certainly will be long term clients, highly recommended
Best place in town. The front desk is always super sweet…
We have gone to multiple groomers for our goldendoodle and they hurt her and don't give consistent Cuts but this place is different and does a good job. Consistent haircuts
They do a great job of keeping my poodle mix clean and groomed.
Have not been disappointed yet after several years and two dogs.  We have used multiple groomers at this facility and all were excellent

I took my eight month old cockapoo mix puppy in today for the first time there Colina was the groomer and did a fantastic job. Of course he was quite agitated on his first visit and I intend to take him once a month so he gets more used to it, but I’m very pleased With the service
Always do a great job with my poodled

Very happy with the service provided by The Hairy Dog. My dog always gets extreme anxiety at groomers and always gets a case of stress colitis because of that. I emphasized that to the staff here and I’m not sure what they did but I can tell they made my pup feel very comfortable because he was not sick at all. Thank you!

I've used them in the past with good results. However, I recently tried booking an appointment via phone and text but I never got a response. I tried booking  online, but the tool is way too long and cumbersome. I gave up and found another groomer.
